title: Pure Crashbug
summary: Crashbug Level 3 DARK Fiend swarm and stat-inversion build from Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL, supported by Tour Guide From the Underworld and Fiendish Rhino Warrior. Crashbug X, Y, and Z recruit each other from the Deck for Rank 3 Xyz plays before banishing from the GY to summon Super Crashbug and swap every monster's ATK and DEF.

summary.title: Starters
points: Tour Guide From the Underworld Normal Summons to Special Summon any Level 3 Fiend (Crashbug X, Crashbug Y, Crashbug Z, or Fiendish Rhino Warrior) directly from the Deck.

Fiendish Rhino Warrior protects all other Fiend monsters you control from battle and card-effect destruction, and sends whichever Crashbug letter you are missing from the Deck to the GY when sent to the GY.
Crashbug X (while you control Y), Crashbug Y (while you control Z), and Crashbug Z (while you control X) each Special Summon the third Crashbug letter from the Deck when Normal Summoned.

summary.title: Opening: Tour Guide + Fiendish Rhino Warrior
steps: Normal Summon Tour Guide From the Underworld and Special Summon Fiendish Rhino Warrior from the Deck.
Overlay Tour Guide and Rhino into a Rank 3 Xyz (such as Muzurhythm the String Djinn or Number 49: Fortune Tune) and detach Rhino to send a Crashbug monster from the Deck to the GY.

Once Crashbug X, Y, and Z are in the GY, banish all three to Special Summon Super Crashbug in Attack Position (3000 DEF becomes 3000 ATK), then use Leviair the Sea Dragon to bring one of the banished Crashbugs back to the field.

summary.title: Stat Swap & Bosses
points: Super Crashbug swaps the ATK and DEF of all face-up Attack Position monsters on the field while it is in Attack Position, turning its own 0 ATK / 3000 DEF into 3000 ATK and Crashbug X's 0 ATK / 2000 DEF into 2000 ATK while crippling high-ATK, low-DEF opposing bosses.

Leviair the Sea Dragon detaches 1 material to Special Summon a banished Crashbug X, Y, or Z back to the field, Muzurhythm the String Djinn doubles its ATK to 3000 when attacking, and Number 34: Terror-Byte steals an opponent's Level 4 or lower monster.
Number 49: Fortune Tune cannot be targeted or destroyed (detaching instead), gains 500 LP each Standby Phase, and recycles 2 Level 3 Crashbugs back to the Deck when sent to the GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Crashbug Road is a Quick-Play Spell that lets players Special Summon a monster from their hand with the same Level as a face-up monster they control, letting you field a second Crashbug to satisfy their on-Normal-Summon recruitment condition.

Shield & Sword swaps the original ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters on the field until the End Phase, and Inverse Universe permanently swaps the ATK and DEF of all face-up Effect Monsters on the field when Super Crashbug is not yet out.
